title: Zesty and Light Tunisian Monkfish Tagine
description: A flavorful and light Tunisian dish featuring monkfish in a tangy miso-based marinade, served with a side of couscous and vegetables.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, cumin, cinnamon, and paprika to make the marinade.
Add the monkfish fillets to the marinade and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Remove the monkfish from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
In a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot, heat a tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat.
Sear the monkfish for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned and cooked through.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise the monkfish for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the monkfish is cooking, prepare the couscous according to package instructions.
Fluff the cooked couscous with a fork and stir in chopped fresh parsley, if using.
To serve, place a monkfish fillet on each plate and serve with a side of couscous and vegetables.
Garnish with additional parsley, if desired.
